## Accepted Artin–Tate structural partial, attempt 1/5

AIM Problem 3.2 / AIM-ALGEBRAIC_GEOMETRY-0032, numeric ID 20000032, rank 1262. The exact BHS i2-module category A = Mod_{SH(R)^AT}(1₂)[a⁻¹] and, separately, its derived 2-completion D = A₂^∧ each require exactly countably many compact generators. No finite set suffices. Consequently neither is equivalent to Mod_R for any ordinary associative ring spectrum, even without monoidal compatibility. Finite-object spectral-category and affine spectral-scheme module models are also excluded.

The full proof preserves the special-fiber weight vanishing, w−N sign, finite-weight support, nonzero witnesses, compact Moore generators, 4·id Moore bound and algebra-based 2·id_B argument. The order defining D is fixed: no completion/localization interchange is asserted.

A standalone authored quotient correction proves that ordinary thick(Ca) is strictly smaller than the required compact thick tensor ideal, using the explicit weight-one E(1) witness. The full strictness proof and independent mathematical audit are retained. Known filtered-algebra, telescope and odd-prime models remain carefully credited and scoped; no infinite-totalization/geometric-fixed-point interchange is made.

The intrinsic deformation ring/stack recognition remains unresolved by this work. This is a formal structural consequence of published BHS inputs, with novelty unclaimed. No integral arithmetic-gluing or all-stacks exclusion is asserted.

## Edition and review boundary

Exactly seven proof/audit/status and public-source-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/20000032/`. The main proof is byte-identical to the accepted proof; the quotient note and audit have only documented editorial reframing and public-version bindings. Complete mathematical arguments and source hypotheses remain included.

No programs, checker outputs, computational results, fixtures, datasets, copied third-party source documents/images or private coordination material are distributed. No excluded computation is converted into proof prose. Public source metadata preserves scholarly titles, URLs, document hashes/sizes, publication status and historical retrieval/inspection limits. Preparation adds no new source retrieval, source inspection or novelty search claim.

The edition is AI-assisted and unrefereed. Scoped mathematical acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. The original intrinsic-recognition target is not solved. Editorial preparation adds no substantive proof turn; attempt 1/5 is retained. QUEUE.md and all unrelated entries are unchanged. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.
